usedFor: Sales teams keep leads in Breakcold, where “New Lead” starts a template and “Create Reminder” sets a follow-up.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Sent” in Gmail, then “Create or Update Lead” in Breakcold
bestTemplate.why: Each email you send becomes a lead, or updates one already there, so the CRM keeps up with outreach.

watchOut: “Create or Update Lead” in Breakcold also updates an existing lead, so check what a run may overwrite.
